## What happened

What was seen, with the exact output or measurement.

## What the spec says

Digest file and section, or the test that should have caught it.

## How to see it again

1. One action per step.

## Evidence

Log lines, result files, device model and software build.

## Missing test

Which test level (L0 to L4) should have caught this, and the test to add with the fix.
